purpose: Teach: カーソル/落合/錬金術/色気/ポルシェ/初恋/川柳/バッシング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがパソコンでカーソルの動かし方を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad taught me how to move the cursor on the computer.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy. Gentle smile in the voice. Sharing something small that mattered to him. Soft pace, like she's watching him learn.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと落合監督の本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — me and Dad read a book about Manager Ochiai.
lines.style: Bright, eager. Quick speech. Wants her approval. Small proud edge — he did something grown-up. Open, unguarded delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが錬金術のお話をして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad told me a story about alchemy.
lines.style: Soft wonder in her voice. Lingering slightly on the image. Not explaining, just sharing what she noticed. Quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、色気って言葉、お父さんに聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I asked Dad what the word 'allure' means.
lines.style: Curious, slightly hesitant. Testing the word in his mouth. Not embarrassed but aware he's asking about something adult. Genuine question, genuine wondering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがポルシェの展示会に連れて行って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad took me to a Porsche exhibition.
lines.style: Tender admiration. Lingering on the generosity of it. Not showing off — just privately marveling at what he noticed her noticing. Slow, savoring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵本で初恋のお話読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I read a story about first love in a picture book.
lines.style: Open and bright. Small excitement in the voice. Still a child's wonder. Unself-conscious. Quick pace, warm delivery — wants to share what moved him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが川柳の作り方を教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — Dad's going to teach me how to write senryu poems.
lines.style: Soft gratitude and anticipation in her voice. Not announcing — confiding. She's watching how he opens the world to Sho. Quiet joy underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ニュースでバッシングって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I heard the word 'bashing' on the news.
lines.style: Careful, slightly uncertain. Not sure what he's asking. A small worry underneath — why is he asking about something that sounds harsh? Gentle, protective pause.
